title: Money is integer minor units
body: All amounts in ledgerd are i64 minor units (cents) paired with an ISO 4217 currency code. Never use f64 for money, not even in tests or dashboards. The Money newtype in crates/money rejects arithmetic across currencies.

title: Errors use thiserror in libraries and anyhow at the edge
body: Library crates define typed errors with thiserror so callers can match on them. Only the binary crates and request handlers use anyhow, and they attach context with with_context before returning.

title: Handlers return ApiError never raw status codes
body: Every axum handler returns Result<Json<T>, ApiError>. ApiError maps domain errors to a stable JSON body with a machine readable code field, so clients never parse messages.

title: Migrations are forward only and reviewed by the data owner
body: We never write down migrations. A bad migration is fixed with a new migration. Every migration file needs an approval from the data owner on the pull request, and must be safe to run while the old binary is still serving traffic.

title: Commit messages follow conventional commits
body: Use feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor and test prefixes. Breaking changes carry a BREAKING CHANGE footer. The release tool builds the changelog from these prefixes, so a missing prefix drops the change from release notes.

title: Public API fields are snake_case in JSON
body: Rust structs keep snake_case and serde needs no rename. The TypeScript client converts to camelCase only at the edge in api/client.ts. Do not mix casing inside a single response.

title: Feature flags live in flags.toml and default off
body: New behaviour ships behind a flag declared in config/flags.toml. Flags default to off, are read through the Flags extractor, and are deleted within two releases of reaching 100 percent.

title: Tests use the shared postgres template database
body: Integration tests clone the template database created by xtask test-db instead of running migrations per test. A clone takes about 40 ms. Never point tests at the shared dev database.

title: Log with tracing spans and structured fields
body: Use tracing, not println or log. Put request_id and account_id on the root span. Do not log full card numbers, bearer tokens or customer email addresses; log the last four digits only.

title: React components are function components with hooks only
body: The dashboard in ledger-ui has no class components. Data fetching goes through the useQuery wrappers in src/data, never fetch directly inside a component.

title: Rust formatting and lints are enforced in CI
body: cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy with warnings denied run on every pull request. Allow attributes need a comment explaining why. The nightly rustfmt options in rustfmt.toml are not used.

title: Dependencies are added with cargo add and justified in the PR
body: A new crate needs a sentence in the pull request: what it does, why std or an existing dependency is not enough, and its license. cargo deny must pass.

title: Posting
body: A posting is one signed amount against one account inside a transaction. A transaction is valid only when its postings sum to zero per currency.

title: Journal
body: The journal is the append-only table of transactions. Rows are never updated or deleted; corrections are new reversing transactions.

title: Settlement window
body: The settlement window is the daily cut-off at 17:00 UTC after which pending transfers roll to the next business day batch.

title: Idempotency key
body: A client-supplied opaque string in the Idempotency-Key header. Replaying a request with the same key within 24 hours returns the stored response instead of posting again.

title: Hold
body: A hold reserves funds on an account without moving them. It reduces available balance but not ledger balance, and expires after seven days unless captured.

title: Reconciliation run
body: A scheduled job that compares the journal against bank statement files and records each mismatch as a break for operations to review.

title: Break
body: A break is a difference found by a reconciliation run between our journal and an external statement: missing, duplicate or amount mismatch.

title: Sweep account
body: An internal account that collects fees and rounding remainders. A nightly sweep moves its balance to the operating bank account.

title: Tenant
body: A tenant is one customer organisation. Every table row carries tenant_id and row level security policies restrict reads to the tenant in the session setting.

title: Outbox
body: The outbox table stores events written in the same database transaction as the state change. A relay process publishes them to NATS and marks them sent.

title: Why the CI cache key includes Cargo.lock
body: The GitHub Actions cache for target and the cargo registry is keyed on the hash of Cargo.lock plus the toolchain version. Keying on Cargo.toml alone served stale artifacts after a transitive bump and produced linker errors.

title: sqlx offline mode needs prepared query data
body: CI builds with SQLX_OFFLINE=true, so the .sqlx directory must be regenerated with cargo sqlx prepare whenever a query! macro changes. The error is 'set DATABASE_URL or run cargo sqlx prepare'.

title: Integration tests are serialized by a postgres advisory lock
body: Tests that touch the settlement tables take advisory lock 7001 so they do not interleave. If a test panics while holding the lock the connection drops and the lock releases, so a hung CI job usually means a different cause.

title: Retry policy for the bank gateway client
body: Calls to the bank gateway retry three times with exponential backoff starting at 200 ms and full jitter. Only 429, 502, 503 and connection resets retry. A 400 is never retried because the request itself is wrong.

title: Connection pool sizing for ledgerd
body: The sqlx pool is capped at 20 connections per pod and pgbouncer fronts the database in transaction mode. Prepared statements are disabled for that reason. Raising the pool beyond 20 starved the settlement worker.

title: Grafana dashboards for ledgerd latency
body: The ledgerd overview dashboard shows p50, p95 and p99 request latency by route. Alert thresholds: p99 above 800 ms for ten minutes pages the on-call. Histogram buckets are defined in telemetry/metrics.rs.

title: On-call runbook for a stuck outbox relay
body: Symptom: outbox rows older than five minutes with sent_at null. Check the relay pod logs for NATS auth errors, then restart the relay deployment. Rows are safe to re-publish because consumers dedupe on event id.

title: Rate limiting uses a token bucket per tenant
body: The RateLimit middleware keeps a token bucket per tenant in Redis with 100 requests per second burst 200. New endpoints inherit it automatically; heavy endpoints can declare a cost greater than one.

title: Pagination uses opaque cursors not offsets
body: List endpoints take a limit up to 200 and an opaque cursor, a base64url encoded keyset of created_at and id. Offset pagination was removed because it was slow and unstable on the journal table.

title: Authentication is a JWT checked by the AuthLayer
body: Requests carry a bearer JWT signed by the identity service. The AuthLayer validates signature, expiry and audience, then inserts Claims into request extensions. Handlers read tenant_id from Claims, never from the body.

title: OpenAPI spec is generated from handler annotations
body: Run cargo xtask openapi after adding a route. The utoipa annotations on handlers produce openapi.json, which the TypeScript client generator consumes. CI fails if the committed file is out of date.

title: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 with a timestamp
body: Outgoing webhooks are signed over timestamp, a dot, and the raw body. Receivers must reject timestamps older than five minutes. Secrets rotate every 90 days with a ten day overlap.

title: Backfills run as chunked jobs not one big statement
body: Large backfills update at most 5000 rows per batch, sleep between batches and record progress in backfill_state. A single UPDATE across the journal held locks for minutes during the March incident.

title: Adding an index concurrently
body: Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY and mark the migration with the no-transaction directive because concurrent builds cannot run inside a transaction. A failed build leaves an invalid index that must be dropped by hand.

title: Renaming a column takes three releases
body: Add the new column and write both, backfill, switch reads, then drop the old column in a later release. A direct ALTER TABLE RENAME breaks the previous binary still running during the rollout.

title: Partitioning the journal by month
body: The journal is range partitioned by created_at month. A cron creates next month's partition seven days ahead. Queries without a created_at bound scan every partition and should be avoided.

title: Row level security needs the tenant setting on every connection
body: Policies read current_setting('app.tenant_id'). The pool hook runs SET LOCAL at the start of each transaction. A query on a fresh connection without it returns zero rows, which looks like missing data.

title: Upgrading axum from 0.6 to 0.7 changes the server API
body: axum::Server is gone; bind a tokio TcpListener and call axum::serve. Extractors that consume the body must be last. The hyper 1.0 types replaced those from hyper 0.14 in middleware signatures.

title: sqlx 0.7 to 0.8 requires regenerating offline data
body: The offline query format changed, so delete .sqlx and run cargo sqlx prepare again. The Executor trait bounds also changed, which breaks generic repository helpers.

title: Pinning the Rust toolchain for reproducible builds
body: rust-toolchain.toml pins the stable version. Bump it deliberately in its own pull request after running the full test suite, since new clippy lints can fail CI on untouched code.

title: Node and pnpm versions for ledger-ui
body: The dashboard builds on Node 20 with pnpm 9, declared in package.json engines and .nvmrc. Mixing npm and pnpm lockfiles broke the Docker build once.

title: Dashboard charts use Recharts with memoized series
body: Chart data is memoized with useMemo keyed on the query result, because passing a new array each render restarted the Recharts animation and caused visible flicker.

title: Date handling in the UI uses date-fns with UTC
body: The API returns RFC 3339 UTC timestamps. The UI formats them with date-fns-tz in the viewer's zone, but settlement dates are shown in UTC because the settlement window is defined in UTC.

title: Money formatting goes through formatMoney only
body: formatMoney in src/lib/money.ts takes minor units and a currency code and uses Intl.NumberFormat. Zero decimal currencies like JPY are handled there. Do not divide by 100 in components.

title: Playwright tests need the mock API server
body: End to end tests run against msw handlers started by pnpm test:e2e. Tests that call the real backend are flaky in CI and are not allowed.

title: Bundle size budget for the dashboard
body: The main chunk must stay under 250 kB gzipped. The size-limit check fails the build. Lazy load the reports route and avoid importing all of lodash.

title: Review checklist for money-moving changes
body: Check that postings sum to zero, the idempotency key is honoured, amounts are minor units, and a test covers the reversal path. Money-moving changes need two approvals.

title: What reviewers look for in SQL changes
body: Ask for EXPLAIN output on new queries over the journal, confirm tenant_id appears in the predicate, and verify that new indexes are built concurrently.

title: Unsafe code is banned outside the ffi crate
body: The workspace sets forbid(unsafe_code) except in crates/hsm-ffi, which wraps the signing library. Any new unsafe block there needs a SAFETY comment and a security review.

title: Flaky settlement test was a clock race
body: test_cutoff_rolls_to_next_day failed one run in twenty because it read the wall clock twice around 17:00 UTC. Fixed by injecting a Clock trait and using a fixed time in tests. Do not just retry the job.

title: Docker layer cache invalidated by copying the whole repo first
body: The ledgerd Dockerfile copied the entire source before building dependencies, so every change rebuilt all crates. Using cargo chef to build dependencies in an earlier layer cut image builds from 14 minutes to 3.

title: Clippy failure came from a new toolchain lint
body: After the toolchain bumped, needless_borrows_for_generic_args fired in the money crate. The right fix was removing the borrow, not adding an allow attribute.

title: Out of memory in CI linking the test binaries
body: Linking many integration test binaries in parallel exhausted the 7 GB runner. Setting CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 and using lld fixed the killed-by-signal-9 failures.

title: Check the database is ready before running migrations in CI
body: The postgres service container reports started before it accepts connections. Add pg_isready to a wait loop; otherwise the first migration fails with connection refused roughly one run in ten.

title: Duplicate payments came from a retried POST without idempotency key
body: A client library retried a timed out POST /transfers and posted twice. Root cause: the key was generated per attempt rather than per logical request. Server now rejects transfers without an Idempotency-Key.

title: High p99 was caused by an unbounded query on the journal
body: An account statement endpoint omitted the created_at bound and scanned all partitions. Adding the date bound and a default thirty day window brought p99 from 4 s to 120 ms.

title: Memory growth in ledgerd traced to an unbounded channel
body: The webhook dispatcher used an unbounded mpsc channel; a slow customer endpoint let it grow until the pod was OOM killed. Replaced with a bounded channel and drop-oldest backpressure plus a metric.

title: Dead letter queue filled after a schema change
body: A consumer deserialized events with deny_unknown_fields, so adding a field to the payload sent every message to the dead letter queue. Consumers must ignore unknown fields.

title: Reconciliation breaks spiked from timezone parsing of bank files
body: One bank switched statement timestamps from UTC to local time at the daylight saving change, shifting transactions across the settlement window. The parser now requires an explicit offset and fails loudly without it.

title: Migration locked the accounts table during deploy
body: Adding a NOT NULL column with a default rewrote the table on Postgres 11 and blocked writes for 90 seconds. Add the column nullable, backfill in chunks, then add the constraint as NOT VALID and validate separately.

title: Foreign key validation on a big table needs NOT VALID
body: Adding a foreign key to postings scanned the whole table under a lock. Create it NOT VALID and run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT afterwards, which takes a weaker lock.

title: Enum changes in Postgres cannot be reverted in a transaction
body: ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE cannot be used in the same transaction as a statement that uses the new value. Split into two migrations. Prefer a lookup table for values that change often.

title: serde default needed after adding a field to a stored JSON blob
body: Old rows in the metadata column lacked the new field and deserialization failed in production. Add serde(default) when extending types that are persisted, and cover an old-shape fixture in a test.

title: tower layer ordering changed after the axum upgrade
body: Layers added with ServiceBuilder apply top to bottom, but Router::layer applies bottom to top. After upgrading, the AuthLayer ran after the RateLimit layer and unauthenticated traffic consumed tenant tokens.

title: A minor bump of the jwt crate rejected our tokens
body: The new version validates the nbf claim by default and enforces a required audience. Tokens from the identity service without nbf started failing; set validate_nbf false explicitly or fix the issuer.

title: Renovate PRs for tokio must be grouped with tokio-util
body: Bumping tokio alone produced duplicate versions in the dependency tree and a trait mismatch compile error. Grouping tokio, tokio-util and tokio-stream in renovate.json avoids it.

title: React Query cache key must include the tenant
body: Switching tenant in the header showed the previous tenant's balances until refetch because query keys omitted tenant_id. Include it in every key, and clear the cache on tenant switch.

title: Hydration mismatch from locale dependent formatting
body: Server rendered dates used the server locale and the client used the browser locale, causing a hydration warning. Pass the locale explicitly to formatters instead of relying on defaults.

title: Large CSV export froze the browser tab
body: Building a 200k row CSV in memory on the main thread blocked the UI. The export now streams from a server endpoint with a signed download URL.

title: Reviewers missed a missing tenant filter in a new query
body: A report query joined postings without tenant_id and leaked cross-tenant totals in staging. The review checklist now requires a tenant predicate on every query; a lint script greps for it.

title: Large pull requests got rubber stamped
body: Pull requests over 800 changed lines received approvals within minutes and later caused incidents. Split changes by concern; reviewers may ask to split anything above 400 lines.

title: Ledger data model overview
body: Accounts hold postings; postings belong to transactions; transactions are written to the journal and never mutated. Balances are derived by summing postings and cached in account_balances, which is rebuilt from the journal if it drifts. See Money is integer minor units and Posting.

title: Payment lifecycle from request to settlement
body: A transfer request is validated, a hold is placed, the transaction is posted to the journal, an event goes through the outbox, and the next settlement window batches it for the bank gateway. Failures at the gateway trigger the retry policy and, finally, a reversal.

title: Service architecture of ledgerd
body: ledgerd is an axum HTTP service backed by Postgres through sqlx, with a Redis rate limiter, a NATS event bus, and a settlement worker run as a separate deployment. ledger-ui is a React dashboard that talks to the public API only.

title: Local development setup
body: Install the pinned Rust toolchain and Node 20 with pnpm. Run docker compose up for Postgres, Redis and NATS, then cargo xtask test-db and cargo run -p ledgerd. The dashboard starts with pnpm dev in ledger-ui.

title: Release process
body: Merging to main builds an image tagged with the git sha and deploys to staging. A release is cut by tagging; the pipeline then runs smoke tests and promotes to production with a canary at ten percent.

title: Incident response guide
body: Declare an incident in the on-call channel, assign a commander, keep a timeline, and prefer rollback over forward fixes. A blameless review is written within three working days.

title: Security model and secrets handling
body: Secrets come from the cloud secret manager and are mounted at runtime, never committed. Service to service calls use mTLS; client calls use JWT. Row level security is the last line of defence for tenant isolation.

title: Observability stack
body: Metrics go to Prometheus, traces through OpenTelemetry to Tempo, logs to Loki. Dashboards are in Grafana and alert rules live in the ops repository with the runbooks.

title: Testing strategy
body: Unit tests sit beside the code, integration tests use the template database, and end to end tests run against mocked APIs. Property tests cover the ledger invariants such as postings summing to zero.

title: Database operations overview
body: Postgres 15 with streaming replicas and pgbouncer. The journal is partitioned monthly. Read-only reports use the replica. Backups are daily with point-in-time recovery for seven days.

title: Webhook delivery design
body: Events are delivered at least once with signed payloads and exponential retries for 24 hours. Customers can replay events from the dashboard. Delivery state is tracked per endpoint.

title: Multitenancy design
body: Shared schema with tenant_id on every row, enforced by row level security and by an AuthLayer that sets the tenant on the connection. Noisy tenants are contained by per tenant rate limits.

title: Frontend architecture of ledger-ui
body: Vite and React with React Query for server state, a small design system in src/ui, route level code splitting, and generated API types from the OpenAPI spec.

title: Reversing a posted transaction
body: Reversals are new transactions that mirror the original postings with opposite sign and a reverses_id reference. The journal itself is never edited. The reverse endpoint is idempotent on the original id.

title: Currency conversion rates are snapshotted per transaction
body: Cross currency transfers store the FX rate and its source timestamp on the transaction so later audits can reproduce amounts. Rates come from a cached provider feed refreshed every minute.
